reason: The commit only adds explicit int32_t casts to the existing depth-limit comparisons. It does not change an entry point, protocol, state model, configuration, input semantics, or attack surface. H0 already reaches wuffs_aux::DecodeJson through fuzz_cpp and lets input-controlled JSON nesting exercise the changed depth comparison. The analogous wuffs_aux::DecodeCbor edit does not create a new CBOR behavior or materially aggravate any pre-existing absence of CBOR coverage.
evidence: In wuffs_aux::DecodeJson, `depth > WUFFS_JSON__DECODER_DEPTH_MAX_INCL` becomes `depth > (int32_t)WUFFS_JSON__DECODER_DEPTH_MAX_INCL`; `depth` remains `int32_t` and all surrounding control flow is unchanged.
H0's `fuzz_cpp` invokes `wuffs_aux::DecodeJson(callbacks, input, DecodeJsonArgQuirks(...), DecodeJsonArgJsonPointer(...))`, directly reaching the changed auxiliary JSON function.
H0 supplies arbitrary JSON bytes through `MemoryInput` and tracks nested structures through `Callbacks::Push` and `Callbacks::Pop`, so nesting depth remains input-controlled.
The same cast-only edit in `wuffs_aux::DecodeCbor` is duplicated in `release/c/wuffs-unsupported-snapshot.c`; no CBOR API, callback protocol, or decoding semantics are added or changed.
recommended_action: No harness maintenance is needed for this commit.
